name: Mountain View Wood Works
old_description: Welcome to Mountain View, where creativity meets craftsmanship! We’re thrilled to invite you to experience our handcrafted and 3D Printed wonders firsthand at local craft shows and events near you.
about:
Mountain View Wood Works operates from Troy, Virginia, in the foothills of Central Virginia. The business is a small, father-and-son production shop that blends precision technology with handmade craftsmanship.

The shop specializes in CNC machining, laser engraving, and 3D printing, producing items such as award plaques, pantry organization can racks, custom signage, and home decor. It also offers custom design services and print-on-demand production for customer-supplied designs. The 3D printing arm, Mountain View 3D, is an authorized printer for several independent designers including Zou3D, Cinderwing, and Flexi Factory.

Customers include craft-show attendees, hobbyists, and organizations seeking personalized awards or signage. The company sells directly at local craft events and ships printed parts to clients who need rapid turnaround on 3D-printed tools, decor, and accessories.

The founders emphasize combining digital fabrication with the warmth of handmade work, offering quick production times and reliable shipping while maintaining quality across both wood and polymer outputs.
